INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS.

2. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Only memorise without using the language
   B. Mix random languages with no purpose
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

3. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
